title: Could not put it down
detail: Finished it in two nights. The recommendation was spot on.

title: Good, not great
detail: Well written but slow in the middle. Lovely edition though.

title: Beautiful edition
detail: Clothbound, good paper, lies flat. A pleasure to hold.

title: Perfect gift
detail: Wrapped beautifully and arrived in two days.

title: Ribbon marker
detail: Small thing, but the ribbon marker and the sewn binding made my week.

title: Print is small
detail: Fine story, but the type is small and the margins are tight.

title: Read it twice
detail: The ending sent me back to page one. Rare.

title: Arrived with a dented corner
detail: Packaging was thin. The book is fine, the corner is not.

title: Great translation
detail: Reads like it was written in English. No awkward sentences.

title: Big for the shelf
detail: Larger format than expected. Check the dimensions.

title: The maps alone
detail: The endpaper maps are worth the price. The story is a bonus.

title: Not for beginners
detail: Dense and rewarding, but start elsewhere if you are new to the subject.

title: Paperback is sturdy
detail: Flexible cover, opens flat, survived a beach week.

title: Half the price elsewhere
detail: Beautiful shop, but I found the same edition cheaper.

title: Signed copy
detail: I did not expect the signature on the title page. Delighted.

title: Slow start, strong finish
detail: Give it fifty pages. Then you will not stop.

title: Kids loved it
detail: Read aloud three nights running. The pictures hold up to a torch.

title: Index is excellent
detail: For a reference book, the index is what matters, and this one is thorough.

title: Smells like a bookshop
detail: Uncoated paper, sewn spine. Old fashioned in the best way.

title: Too short
detail: Loved every page, wanted a hundred more.

title: Second volume please
detail: Ends on a cliff. Hoping the next one is on its way.

title: Good notes
detail: The introduction and notes add context without getting in the way.
